title: aye mere kadiyal jawaan
body:
gir padaa hun sunke teri aah, jalti ret par, phat raha hai mere seene me mera zakhmi jigar, tu nahi zakhmi hua hai aye mere noore nazar
zaalimo ne mere seene par chalaai hai sinaa
aye mere kadiyal jawaan, tujhko mai dhoondhun kahaan.
1. yaad mujhko mere bachpan ka zamana aagaya
maan ki tarhaa tu bhi atthaara baras mein chal
basaa phasliyaan amma ki tootin chid gaya seena
tera bekasi se haath malte rehgaya ye natawaan
aye mere kadiyal jawaan,tujhko mai dhoondhun
<<MINI>>
kahaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. yaad aati thi mujhe jab bhi rasoolallah ki
dil ko hojaata sukoon jab dekhta soorat teri
haan wahi soorat yahaan hai khoon mein doobi
hui baad tere zindagi par khaak ho
aye mere kadiyal jawaan , tujhko mai dhoondun
<<MINI>>
kahaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. maut aayi hai tumhein mai jeeraha hun ay pisar
iss zaeefi me lagaa ye zakhm mere qalb par
mai yahaan aur umme laila bhi tadapti hai udhar
karrahi hai zainab e kubra bhi ye rokar fughaan
aye mere kadiyal jawaan, tujhko mai dhoondun
<<MINI>>
kahaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. subhe dam teri azaan se goonj utthi karbobala
zohr ke daoraan tu meri jamaa’at mein rahaa
abb zaraa dekho namaaze asr ka waqt aagaya
jao beta asr ki abb khuld mein dena azaan
<<DIVIDER>>
hayyaa alaa khairil amal….
5. jab shahe deen ne ali akber ko ran mein paaliyaa
zeen se aae zameen par kaamp utti karbalaa
dekh kar babaa ki haalat roke akber ne kahaa
<<DIVIDER>>
jaame kausar leke ran mein aagae hai dadajaan
mere pyaare babajaan mai chala sooe jinaan
6. maa se matt kehna meri tashnaalabi ka
waqayaa
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bhi math kehna jigar seena ke baahar aagaya aur phupi zainab se kehna muskuraakar margaya
warna marjaaengi khaime mein sabhi saidaaniyaan
mere pyaare babajaan mai chalaa sooe jinaan
